description: This script is a shell utility for automating Flutter project management tasks such as discovering the project directory, and running pub get, analyze, and test commands within that directory. It searches for project markers like specific files and configurations to locate the Flutter app directory.

methods.name: discover_app_dir
methods.description: Locates the Flutter project directory by checking for specific marker files and directory structures.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that verifies prerequisites, determines the project directory, and executes specified Flutter commands.
